name: Google Cloud asset inventory: compute instances
description: Google Cloud Compute Engine VM instances as Cloud Asset Inventory exports them (sourcetype google:gcp:compute:instance): one snapshot record per instance, its machine type, network attachment, disks and scheduling policy, as the Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform indexes it.
source: Cloud Asset Inventory Asset resource reference; Compute Engine API v1 discovery document (Instance, AttachedDisk, NetworkInterface, Scheduling schemas); Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform props.conf and transforms.conf, read live from a running instance

earliest.label: since
earliest.hint: On _time, which is export or ingest time, not the instance's own creationTimestamp or lastStartTimestamp.

feed.label: GCP compute instance inventory
feed.description: A Cloud Asset Inventory snapshot of one Compute Engine VM instance: identity, machine type, network interfaces, attached disks, scheduling policy and lifecycle status at export time.

resource_name.label: Resource name
resource_name.description: The Cloud Asset Inventory full resource name of the instance: //compute.googleapis.com/projects/<project>/zones/<zone>/instances/<instance>.

instance_short_name.label: Instance name
instance_short_name.description: The Compute Engine instance's own short name, as the client set it when the instance was created.

instance_self_link.label: Instance self link
instance_self_link.description: The server-defined URL for the instance resource itself.

asset_type.label: Asset type
asset_type.description: The Cloud Asset Inventory asset type; the discriminator for this feed. compute.googleapis.com/Instance names a Compute Engine VM asset.

machine_type.label: Machine type
machine_type.description: The machine type resource used for this instance, for example n1-standard-1, taken from the full or partial machineType URL.

internal_ip.label: Internal IP
internal_ip.description: The instance's primary internal IPv4 address on its network interface.

instance_address.label: Instance address (combined)
instance_address.description: A multivalue field combining the instance's internal address with its external (natIP) address when one is assigned. Empty for an instance with no external access config, as in this sample.
instance_address.notes: Read from the TA's own EVAL, not a vendor page: EVAL-ip = mvappend(if(network_ip=="null",null(), network_ip), if(nat_ip=="null",null(), nat_ip)).

network_interface_name.label: Network interface name
network_interface_name.description: The server-generated name of the network interface, for example nic0.

fingerprint.label: Optimistic-locking fingerprint
fingerprint.description: A hash of the object's contents used for optimistic locking on update, not a stable identifier.

vpc_network.label: VPC network
vpc_network.description: The URL of the VPC network resource the network interface attaches to.

subnetwork.label: Subnetwork
subnetwork.description: The URL of the Subnetwork resource the network interface uses.

alias_ip_range_cidr.label: Alias IP range CIDR
alias_ip_range_cidr.description: The IP CIDR range covered by an alias IP range on the network interface.

alias_ip_range_name.label: Alias IP range subnetwork range name
alias_ip_range_name.description: The subnetwork secondary range name the alias IP range allocates from.

zone.label: Zone
zone.description: The zone the instance resides in, for example us-east1-c. Cloud Asset Inventory's resource.location and the Compute API's zone URL both name it.

resource_parent.label: Resource parent
resource_parent.description: The full name of the immediate parent resource in the Cloud Asset Inventory hierarchy, typically the owning project.

resource_ancestors.label: Resource ancestors
resource_ancestors.description: The full ancestry path of the asset in the resource hierarchy, project up through any folders to the organization.

account_id.label: Account id (broken)
account_id.description: Intended as the owning account or customer id. The TA aliases it from a field named customerId, which does not appear anywhere in a Cloud Asset Inventory compute instance record, so it is always empty for this sourcetype.
account_id.notes: Read from the TA's own FIELDALIAS, not a vendor page: FIELDALIAS-splunk_gcp_compute_instance_vendor_account = "customerId" as vendor_account.

instance_label.label: Instance label
instance_label.description: A label key applied to the instance. Labels are a free-form tenant-defined key/value map documented as a map type, not a fixed field list; which keys exist depends on the tenant and the instance.
instance_label.notes: The specific literal (goog-gke-node in this sample, a GKE node pool marker) is observed, not a fixed vendor value.

boot_disk_source.label: Disk source
boot_disk_source.description: The URL of the persistent disk resource an attached disk was created from. The TA's image_id field name is misleading: it carries this disk source URL, not an image id.

disk_auto_delete.label: Disk auto-delete
disk_auto_delete.description: Whether the disk is deleted automatically when the instance that uses it is deleted.

disk_boot.label: Disk is boot disk
disk_boot.description: Whether this is the instance's boot disk; the VM uses its first partition as the root filesystem.

disk_device_name.label: Disk device name
disk_device_name.description: The device name reflected into /dev/disk/by-id/ on the guest OS for this attached disk.

disk_size_gb.label: Disk size (GB)
disk_size_gb.description: The size of the attached disk in base-2 gigabytes. The API returns this as a numeric string.

disk_guest_os_feature.label: Guest OS feature
disk_guest_os_feature.description: A guest OS capability the disk's image supports, for example UEFI boot or a multiqueue virtio-scsi controller.

disk_index.label: Disk index
disk_index.description: A zero-based index for this attached disk; index 0 is reserved for the boot disk.

disk_interface.label: Disk interface
disk_interface.description: The disk interface used to attach this disk to the instance, SCSI or NVME.

disk_licenses.label: Disk licenses
disk_licenses.description: URLs of any publicly visible licenses that apply to the attached disk's image.

disk_mode.label: Disk mode
disk_mode.description: The mode the disk is attached in, read-write or read-only.

disk_type.label: Disk type
disk_type.description: Whether the attached disk is a persistent disk or a local scratch disk.

instance_id.label: Instance id
instance_id.description: The server-defined unique numeric identifier for this instance resource.

can_ip_forward.label: Can IP forward
can_ip_forward.description: Whether the instance may send and receive packets whose source or destination does not match its own address; required to use the instance to forward routes.

cpu_platform.label: CPU platform
cpu_platform.description: The CPU platform the instance runs on, for example Intel Haswell.

creation_time.label: Creation time
creation_time.description: When the instance was created, RFC3339 text with the zone's own UTC offset, not the export or ingest time.

deletion_protection.label: Deletion protection
deletion_protection.description: Whether the instance is protected against deletion.

last_start_time.label: Last start time
last_start_time.description: The last time the instance was started, RFC3339 text with the zone's own UTC offset.

scheduling_automatic_restart.label: Automatic restart
scheduling_automatic_restart.description: Whether Compute Engine automatically restarts the instance if it is terminated by Compute Engine rather than by the user.

scheduling_on_host_maintenance.label: On-host maintenance behavior
scheduling_on_host_maintenance.description: How the instance behaves during a host maintenance event: migrate to another host, or terminate.

scheduling_preemptible.label: Preemptible
scheduling_preemptible.description: Whether the instance is preemptible: it can be reclaimed by Compute Engine at any time at no charge.

service_accounts.label: Service accounts
service_accounts.description: The service accounts, with their scopes, authorized for this instance. Empty in this sample; no example is given because none is observed.

start_restricted.label: Start restricted
start_restricted.description: Whether the instance is restricted from starting, for example after a billing suspension.

cai_discovery_document_uri.label: Discovery document URI
cai_discovery_document_uri.description: The URL of the discovery document that carries the resource's JSON schema.

cai_discovery_name.label: Discovery schema name
cai_discovery_name.description: The JSON schema name listed in the discovery document for this resource, Instance for a Compute Engine VM.

cai_resource_version.label: Resource API version
cai_resource_version.description: The API version the resource data was captured at, for example v1.

google:gcp:compute:instance.description: Cloud Asset Inventory's JSON export for a compute.googleapis.com/Instance asset, as the Splunk Add-on for Google Cloud Platform (Splunk_TA_google-cloudplatform) indexes a Cloud Storage bucket export: the Asset object's own dotted paths, plus the TA's own EXTRACT, EVAL and FIELDALIAS fields.
google:gcp:compute:instance.note: disks{}, networkInterfaces{} and their nested paths are multivalue; ancestors{} is a plain multivalue list. One event observed in the dev index; the TA also supports a pull mode with the same field shape.

provenance.statement: The Cloud Asset Inventory export's top-level name field.
REPORT regex pulls the projects/.../instances/... path out of the raw name field, dropping the //compute.googleapis.com/ prefix.
EXTRACT regex pulls the machineTypes/<value> segment out of the machineType URL.
EXTRACT regex pulls networkInterfaces[0].networkIP out of the raw event.
EXTRACT regex pulls networkInterfaces[0].name out of the raw event.
EXTRACT regex pulls networkInterfaces[0].network out of the raw event.
EXTRACT regex pulls networkInterfaces[0].subnetwork out of the raw event.
EXTRACT regex pulls the zones/<value> segment out of the zone URL. Despite the field name, the value is a zone (us-east1-c), not a region (us-east1).
FIELDALIAS-splunk_gcp_compute_instance_vendor_account: "customerId" as vendor_account. No customerId key exists in a Cloud Asset Inventory compute instance record, so this field is always empty here.
EXTRACT regex captures the first key under resource.data.labels as category.

bindings.note: The field name is the label's own key; it changes with whatever labels the tenant applies.

provenance.statement: EXTRACT regex captures the first disk's source URL as image_id, despite the field name.

snapshot_not_event.text: This is an inventory snapshot, not an event stream. _time is export or ingest time and has no fixed relation to creationTimestamp or lastStartTimestamp, which also carry their own non-UTC offset.

id_lookalikes.text: resource.data.id (the instance), the project number in resource.parent or ancestors{}, and the organization number in ancestors{} are all bare decimal strings of similar shape but name different things.

fingerprint_not_id.text: fingerprint, labelFingerprint and a network interface's own fingerprint are optimistic-locking hashes, not identifiers; each changes on every write to the object it guards.

int_as_string.text: resource.data.id and disks{}.diskSizeGb are numeric-looking JSON strings, not numbers; a numeric comparison in SPL needs an explicit cast.

mv_sibling_misalign.text: disks{}.* and networkInterfaces{}.* are separate multivalue fields; their values do not pair by position without mvzip or mvexpand.

label_key_as_field.text: resource.data.labels.<key> promotes a tenant's own label key into the field name; which fields exist, and what they mean, varies by tenant and instance.

broken_alias.text: vendor_account is aliased from a field named customerId, which does not appear in a Cloud Asset Inventory compute instance record; the field is always empty for this sourcetype.

zone_not_region.text: vendor_region is extracted from the zone URL and holds a zone (us-east1-c), not a region (us-east1), despite the field name.
